basis: Block’s May 5 shareholder letter was the earliest qualifying communication found. For the three months ended March 31, its consolidated GAAP table shows total net revenue of $3,960,645,000 in 2022 and $5,057,270,000 in 2021. The 21.68% decline cleared the 5% threshold of $4,804,406,500. Both figures include bitcoin revenue. The 2022 total also includes $130 million from Afterpay for February and March, following the January 31 acquisition.

coverage.detail: November 4, 2021, Q3 shareholder letter. Square discussed October payment volume and ecosystem gross profit and projected a $115 million sequential increase in selected Q4 non-GAAP expenses. It gave no Q1 2022 consolidated revenue bound.
On the November 4 call, the CFO’s preliminary 2022 figure was approximately 40% full-year non-GAAP expense growth excluding Afterpay. The Q1 reference concerned the expected acquisition closing.
January 31, 2022. Block announced completion of the Afterpay acquisition. The closing established when Afterpay entered the reporting group and supplied no combined Q1 revenue forecast.

February 24, Q4 shareholder letter. Block projected 35% Square payment-volume growth for January and February combined and a $180 million sequential increase in Q1 non-GAAP operating expenses including Afterpay. Its warning about the strong prior-year bitcoin comparison gave no numeric ceiling on Q1 revenue.

On the February 24 call, the CFO expected February Afterpay revenue growth in a range similar to its 25%–30% merchandise-volume growth. The outlook for the remainder of Q1 concerned Square and Cash App gross profit. Neither statement bounded consolidated quarterly revenue.
April 4. Block discussed the expected impact of a Cash App Investing data incident without providing a Q1 revenue estimate.
April 5. Block scheduled its Q1 results for May 5 after market close. The notice contained no preliminary figures.
April 7. Block announced that management’s investor-day presentation would take place May 18, after the Q1 release. The announcement gave no Q1 sales outlook.

April 11. The Afterpay acquisition exhibit presented pro forma combined operations for the year ended December 31, 2021, assuming a January 1, 2021 acquisition. It supplied neither reported Q1 2022 revenue nor a Q1 forecast.

The public transcript index lists the February 24 and May 5 earnings calls consecutively. Searches for intervening management remarks, investor presentations and preliminary results identified no earlier consolidated Q1 revenue figure.

May 5. Item 2.02 confirms that Block issued the shareholder letter that day announcing financial results for the first quarter ended March 31, 2022. Exhibit 99.1 contains the comparative GAAP figures in thousands of dollars.

publication_date_evidence: Block expressly dated public issuance to May 5 in Item 2.02. EDGAR accepted the 8-K with the shareholder letter attached at 16:18:53 that same day: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1512673/000119312522142338/0001193125-22-142338-index.htm
